items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Yes, yeah, he's our manager now. He leads the band. Yeah, he's doing a pretty good job at it.

ctx.x: Sometimes every three weeks. It all depends. Sometimes every two weeks for quite a while then.

Looks like the boat will be a week later. Yeah, for a while. Yeah. Just talking to Albert today about the boat. You know. That was a pretty good boat. It didn't sail away until about six o'clock. I met one of the fellows that works. He's a pretty good boat. He's a pretty good boat. It didn't sail away until about six o'clock. I met one of the fellows that works. He's a pretty good boat. He's a head of all those boys that carried the suitcases and the grips and all on the boat. Well, he's a head of them. I met him…
You starting at what time is it? Three to four. Three to four.
